title: Document Lifecycle Graph Contract
summary: Accepted normative contract for DLG document metadata, relation semantics, freshness, retrieval, Agent Reading Packets, and staged migration.
authority_scopes: Agent Reading Packet and staged migration doctrine

triggers: ADR-056 is superseded or its accepted scope changes
the DLG node or packet schemas change
DLG phase sequencing or graph-invariant doctrine changes
freshness.reason: Verified after the canonical Phase 1 and Phase 2 sequencing repair.

read_when: creating or reviewing DLG node records
interpreting DLG authority, lifecycle, freshness, evidence, or retrieval fields
planning DLG relationships, semantic validation, or Agent Reading Packets
must_not_prove: a migrated or relation-complete DLG corpus
automatic retrieval, resolver, generator, or graph projection behavior
runtime implementation, agent authority, or release support

section_hints: Canonical token domains and orthogonal axes

relations.authority_scope: DLG document metadata, relationships, freshness, retrieval, and staged-migration doctrine
relations.rationale: ADR-056 adopts the DLG and names this contract as its normative design.
